CustomField.description: The ingestion run that last wrote this row. Makes per-row staleness auditable: if a run halted, the rows it did not touch still point at an older Sync Run, so "which rows are stale" is a query rather than a guess.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The nightly run that last updated this row. Open it to see whether that run completed or halted.
CustomField.label: Sync Run
